story_zh: 我从机场坐出租车到宾馆。宾馆离火车站很近。前面是商店，后面是饭店。我去商店买票，然后进饭店吃饭。吃完饭，我往左边走，去坐公共汽车旅游。公共汽车上人很多。我想回宾馆，但是找不到路。我问：“宾馆在哪？”一个人说：“往右边走，不远。”
story_pinyin: Wǒ cóng jīchǎng zuò chūzūchē dào bīnguǎn. Bīnguǎn lí huǒchēzhàn hěn jìn. Qiánmiàn shì shāngdiàn, hòumiàn shì fàndiàn. Wǒ qù shāngdiàn mǎi piào, ránhòu jìn fàndiàn chīfàn. Chī wán fàn, wǒ wǎng zuǒbiān zǒu, qù zuò gōnggòng qìchē lǚyóu. Gōnggòng qìchē shàng rén hěn duō. Wǒ xiǎng huí bīnguǎn, dànshì zhǎo bù dào lù. Wǒ wèn: “Bīnguǎn zài nǎ?” Yīgè rén shuō: “Wǎng yòubiān zǒu, bù yuǎn.”
story_en: I took a taxi from the airport to the hotel. The hotel is near the train station. In front is a shop, behind is a restaurant. I went to the shop to buy a ticket, then entered the restaurant to eat. After eating, I walked to the left to take a bus for travel. There were many people on the bus. I wanted to return to the hotel but couldn't find the way. I asked, "Where is the hotel?" A person said, "Walk to the right, it's not far."
